about: Benchmark entry G12 (train split) in dev.json format. Tier 4: a wall-mount electronics enclosure with a catalogue board (no mounting holes, antenna keep-out) placed by datums, a plug-envelope opening, three catalogue LEDs held flush in lid collars, countersunk mounting slots with edge distances and a screw-closed lid, judged by interference, clearance and edge-distance checks on the delivered STLs. L1 ids match benchmarks/generalize/designs/G12/requirements.md. Never put any of these numbers in agent logic: they belong in the request text and the part.json catalogue.

methods.inspection: read from the design or mesh (counts, sizes, positions, relations)
methods.analysis: computed by Python (stability, connectivity, interference and clearance against reference models, hand calculations)
methods.demonstration: a stand-in object is placed in the design (fits, rests, does not slide)
methods.test: a probe is applied (insert a plug along its axis, drop the board in, load path)

requests.title: Wall-mount ESP32 box with LED light pipes
requests.request: I need a wall-mounted enclosure for an ESP32 DevKitC V4 board (54.4 x 27.9 mm, no mounting holes, micro-USB at one short end, PCB antenna at the other). It has two mounting ears that take 4.2 mm countersunk wood screws, the two screw slots 100 mm apart, and every slot must leave at least 3 mm to the edge of its ear and to the box. Three 5 mm LEDs shine through the lid: the LEDs sit flush with the outside of the lid and must not fall out. The micro-USB cable must plug in through one short end with the lid on. Keep the antenna end of the board free: no wall or lid over the antenna and at least 8 mm of free space beyond the end of the board. The lid is held by M3 self-tapping screws. It is printed on an FDM printer in PLA, back face down.
requests.request_verbatim: A wall-mounted ESP32 enclosure with two mounting ears taking 4.2 mm countersunk wood screws, 100 mm apart. Three 5 mm LEDs shine through the lid; the LEDs sit flush with the outside and must not fall out. The ear slots must leave at least 3 mm to the box edge.
requests.request_notes: Added to the brief (derived, see requirements.md 3.1 and 3.2): the board has no holes so it rests on four pads and is located by walls and stops (FD2); 'LED light pipes' = each LED in a collar in the lid, dome flush, flange captured and a snap lip behind it (FD5); 'to the box edge' = to the ear's free edges and to the box wall (FD4); '100 mm apart' = between slot centres (FD3); lid closure = four M3 screws in tabs outside the cavity (FD1); antenna numbers (8 mm beyond, 5 mm above the module) from the ESP32 catalogue part; FDM, PLA (A7).

l1.text: The design shall place the ESP32 DevKitC V4 from the catalogue with its micro-USB port facing the −X short end and its antenna toward +X, and place three 5 mm LEDs on the lid, without the parts colliding, and shall declare that layout.

The board shall rest on four pads under its end regions, outside the header footprint, each at least 10 mm², and be located by the walls and two antenna-end stops (0.2 to 1.0 mm from the board, stops below the board's top face), with the printed box clear of the board's keep-out volumes (header pins, tails, component side).

No wall or lid shall enter the board's antenna keep-out, and the cavity shall extend at least 8.0 mm beyond the board's antenna end; the keep-out is the board's last 6.0 mm plus the 8.0 mm beyond it, the full board width, up to 5.0 mm above the module top (from the part's data).

With the lid closed, a micro-USB cable shall plug fully into the board through one opening in the −X end wall with at least 0.3 mm to spare all round the plug, leaving at least 1.5 mm of wall round the opening, and the opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side.

The lid shall hold three 5 mm LEDs in collars with their domes flush with the outside, their flanges captured on a shoulder and a snap lip behind them, so each LED stays in: holes 5.2 to 5.4 mm across, flange overlap at least 0.2 mm per side, domes within 0.3 mm of flush, snap-lip opening 5.3 to 5.6 mm with at least two slits. The LEDs sit in a row at least 10.0 mm apart, each axis at least 4.5 mm in plan from the board's header-pin and antenna keep-outs.

The box shall have two ears, each with a countersunk slot for a 4.2 mm wood screw, the two slot centres 100.0 mm apart, with at least 3.0 mm from each countersink outline to the edge of its ear and to the box. Each slot is a 4.5 mm wide stadium with 4.0 mm between its end centres (for adjustment), under a 90 degree countersink 8.4 mm across; the ears are 3.5 to 5.0 mm thick and the slot centres are symmetric about the box centre within 0.5 mm.
The box shall have a flat back face, with the ears coplanar with it (flat within 0.3 mm), so it sits flat against the wall.

The lid shall be a separate body that locates on the base with a sliding lip and is held by four M3 self-tapping screws in tabs outside the cavity (screw axes 3.5 to 5.0 mm beyond the wall's outer face, pilots 2.4 to 2.6 mm and at least 6.0 mm deep, lid holes 3.4 mm), the sliding lip at least 2.0 mm deep with 0.15 to 0.35 mm clearance per side.

The closed box shall have no openings other than the USB opening, the three LED holes, the lid screw holes and the two ear slots, and its walls, floor and lid shall be 2.0 to 4.0 mm thick, with at least 1.5 mm of material round each opening.
The base shall print on its back face and the lid on its outer face, each as one manifold body without supports.
The closed box with its ears and tabs shall be no larger than 125 x 50 x 26 mm, longest along the board's 54.4 mm side.
The design shall be delivered as a base STL, a lid STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout and the agent's own clearance report, and the report shall agree with an independent measurement.

beyond_library: datum placement: the ESP32's pose, USB_MOUTH / USB_AXIS and its keep-outs (header pins, antenna zone, tails) set the cavity and the opening
holding a board that has no mounting holes: pads under the PCB in the clear end regions and stops round it
two mounting ears with countersunk slots whose size comes from a wood-screw spec, a slot-centre distance and an edge ligament
LED holders in the lid: collars with a through hole, a flange pocket and a snap lip, with the dome flush with the outside
a lid held by four M3 screws in tabs outside the cavity
a cavity sized from an antenna keep-out volume (no material in it, free space beyond the board end)
